normalizerInput: Host-owned JSON cases: id, split, report, store; paths relative to manifest. Held-out entries additionally require freeze and labels paths.
frozenIdentity: Common engine+module code hash and module/options/version/safety configuration hash; individual report hashes/config fingerprints retained per case.
labelsVersion: heurisko-p2-labels-v1 for independent held-out labels; current construction labels are development only.
fileUnits: Unique human-reviewed explanation IDs, matched to frozen independently explainable file/transform labels.
claimReview: Normalizer emits provisional claim candidates, not support labels. Independent reviewers split atomic factual claims, retain citation locations and mark resolved/supported separately, review false escalation/critical failures and explanations; provisional/unreviewed claims cannot pass held-out acceptance.
onePass: Reviewer/rights/family/category/direction minima are checked before grading. One exclusive grading-attempt receipt per eligible freeze; failed detector scores retained and tuning requires a new family-separated reserve.
authorship: Original inert construction/rubric labels are implementing-agent data; public development observations remain unlabeled. No independent review or held-out result is supplied.
counts: Report/category/family, event direction/severity/priority, file explanation, policy and claim/citation units; misses include missing/abstained supported events; duplicate units reject; zero denominators N/A; deterministic family bootstrap.
